text: AI agent failures often start with authority that is broader than the job. Audit what the agent may read, decide, execute and escalate before production.
Before adding another AI tool, map overlap, ownership, human review and break-even. Start with the self-service decision layer, then escalate only if the stack is messy.
Agent tooling changes fast. Brain, Policy, Skills and State should stay portable. Cross-Agent Operating Kit packages that operating layer with human and cost gates.
